title: Clicking a Part Library row opens the entry's detail page
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919). The Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete'.
  • Part Library entry {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-DETAIL-01, description "ZZAUTOTEST PL detail") is stocked at {Location-A} only.
  • The new description {Description-A} (for example "ZZAUTOTEST PL detail edited") is not used by any other entry.
custom_steps:
1. In the top bar click Parts, then click Part Library in the left menu.
  2. Type {Part-A} in the Search box.
  3. Click the {Part-A} row.
  4. Read the Part details panel and the Parts table.
  5. Look over the whole detail page for a Delete button.
  6. Click the pencil icon beside the entry's name in the Part details panel.
  7. Replace the Description with {Description-A}.
  8. Click Save.
  9. Click the pencil icon again.
  10. Look at the bottom left of the window.
  11. Do not click Delete.
  12. Click Cancel.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 3: The entry's detail page opens.
  • Step 4: The Part details panel shows the entry's name, "Part number" {Part-A}, Category, Manufacturer, Measurement and "Total parts" 1, and the Parts table lists one Workplace row for {Location-A}.
  • Step 5: The detail page itself has no Delete button.
  • Step 6: The "Edit Library Part" window opens, holding the entry's values.
  • Step 8: The change is saved: the detail page shows {Description-A}.
  • Step 10: The window's Delete button sits at its bottom left. It is dimmed here, because inventory part {Part-A} still uses the entry.
  • Step 12: The window closes and the entry is unchanged.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10824 (Story 11, The Part Library Is Browse and Edit Only); story SV-10825 (Story 12, Call the Shared Parts List the Part Library); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S11-R3, S11-R3c, S12-R3, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 7.2 (An entry opens its detail page), 13 Oct copy. Product's answer of 13 Oct (Chris Ward, question 12). Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S11-R3: “Clicking a row opens that entry's detail page. The pencil beside the entry's name opens the "Edit Library Part" window, where the entry is edited and where its Delete button sits, bottom left. The detail page itself has no Delete button.”
  • S11-R3c: “While a part still uses the entry, the Delete button is disabled and hovering it shows "Part cannot be deleted. Please delete related parts first."”
  • S12-R3: “The dialog for editing a Part Library entry is titled "Edit Library Part".”
